create_MocapViewerOffline: create a MocapViewerOffline instance to render motion capture data as an offscreen pyrender animation
render_point_MocapViewerOffline: render a colored sphere point at a given index and 3D position in the viewer scene
render_capsule_MocapViewerOffline: render a colored capsule primitive at a given index with position, rotation quaternion, and length
render_ground_MocapViewerOffline: render a grid ground plane with configurable size, color, and axis orientation in the scene
run_pyrender_visualizer_cli: run the pyrender visualizer CLI to load a BVH file and export an HTML5 video animation
